description: Merge several audio files end-to-end into one WAV download.

faqs.a: Each file is decoded and the samples are concatenated in the order you selected them, keeping the original sample rate and channels.
Yes — the tool shows each file's duration and the combined total before you export.
faqs.q: Can I see the total duration?

faqs.a: A 16-bit PCM WAV, the most compatible lossless format.

howto: Drop multiple audio files into the tool.
Check the file list and total duration.
Click Download WAV to save the joined track.
